newsitem.title: USA: All-Comm completes Metro Services purchase.
newsitem.headline: All-Comm completes Metro Services purchase.

text.p: All-Comm Media Corp said Thursday it has completed its acquisition of Metro Services Group Inc, a New York-based provider of database management and other direct marketing services.

Under the deal, Metro stockholders receive 1,815,000 shares of All-Comm common stock and $1.0 million principal amount of promissory notes which, under certain conditions, may be converted into 185,000 shares of All-Comm common stock.
Metro, with about 600 clients in the United States, offers services like customer and market data analysis, database creation and analysis, data warehousing and other products.
